newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil to open Belarus filling station.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil to open Belarus filling station.

text.p: Russia's biggest oil company NK LUKoil is to open on Thursday a $4.5 million gas station in Belarus, LUKoil said.

LUKoil said it would be the biggest station in Eastern Europe, capable of servicing 72 cars simultaneously and has a technical service, a car-washing facility, a parking lot and a spare parts shop, it said in a statement.
The station is set up under a six-year programme aimed to increase LUKoil's total network of stations by 500.
PO Naftan, a refinery located in the Belarus town of Novopolotsk, will supply the station with petrol, it said.
Last year Belarus, LUKoil and Russia's second biggest oil company Yukos signed an agreement to set up a joint venture, including Naftan, in which the Belarus government has a 51 percent stake.
On January 1, 1996, LUKoil had 712 gas stations, including 11 in Turkey, a LUKoil spokesman said.
Since the start of the year LUKoil has opened more stations in Russia, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Kyrgyzstan and Belarus.
